title: Lab · Host
description: One BMC, read by poller.py exporter: its firmware and what Redfish can update, the health of every component, its network interfaces and ports with their links, and every reading by where it lives in the Redfish tree, with its unit and thresholds.

properties.value: Whether the BMC reports a second image of this component in standard Redfish: inactive, staged or armed, beside the running one. 'not reported' means the standard shows none; the vendor may still keep one in its Oem extensions (AMI: DualImageConfigurations). The vendor's view, per model and BMC firmware: make oem SITE=<site> MODEL=<model>

panels.title: The BMC and its Redfish service

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.at AS ended, e.pipeline, e.wave,
  (SELECT r.event->>'component' FROM events r WHERE r.pipeline = e.pipeline AND r.stage = e.stage
     AND r.host = '-' AND r.step = 'run' AND r.state = 'start' LIMIT 1) AS component,
  e.event->>'before' AS before, e.event->>'target' AS target, e.event->>'running' AS running,
  e.state AS result, e.event->>'detail' AS detail
FROM events e
WHERE e.site = '$site' AND e.host = '$host' AND e.step = 'done'
ORDER BY e.at DESC
